capabilities: Generate, summarize, explain, expand and rewrite selections or whole notes at four length levels
Translate text into about 80 languages and fix grammar
Create Markdown tables, Mermaid diagrams and review questions from note content
Run free-form custom prompts from a movable floating editor menu
Fall back across free Gemini models and speed-test them to pick the fastest default
extras: Warns that the API key is stored unencrypted in the plugin's data.json and that the free Gemini plan has daily limits; states there is no telemetry. Includes a built-in tutorial and a 7-language interface. Accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee and Pix.
motivation: The author calls it a study project made to help the community develop their projects and research.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI text tools, so getting writing help means copying text out to external AI services and pasting results back.

relations.evidence: This plugin sends requests to the Google Gemini API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com).

requires.name: Google Gemini API key (free, from Google AI Studio)

summary: AI writing assistant that generates, summarizes, explains, expands, rewrites and translates note text in the editor using the Google Gemini API.
